name: Silhouette Fitting
definition: A process to fit an initial voxel model to an input 3D mesh by matching silhouette voxels to closest silhouette pixels and minimizing an energy function based on distance, tangent, and gradient differences.
summary: Silhouette fitting is a post-processing voxelization technique that refines coarse voxel models by aligning their boundaries with input mesh silhouettes using heuristic search rather than gradient descent.
